title: GameMaker Library: Schuss added, 83 assets
body:
Schuss is in the GameMaker Library from today, new here first: it has no page of its own yet. That makes 83 assets on this page. If you own the library, download again from your itch.io library at no extra cost: the whole library holds it in the folder for minigames and game modes, and NEW 2026-11-08: Schuss only holds Schuss alone, so you only download what changed.

What Schuss is

  • A complete SkiFree style downhill minigame in pure GML: ski, snowboard, sled, a mine cart on rails with switches and gaps, and a raft on a river with a current.
  • Three goals: slalom gates against the clock, coins down the course, or escape a yeti, a boulder or a flood wave that grows as it closes in.
  • Every course is generated from a seed around a hidden safe line, and the package rides it once with its own autopilot before your game gets it, so every seed at every difficulty can be finished clean. The test suite checks that on 150 courses.
  • 42 course pieces drawn in code across snow, mine and river. The rider carves a trail that stays on the slope, powder sprays on hard turns, and a crash tumbles the rider and throws the skis. No sprite art ships.
  • One call starts a run, your input drives it, and events tell your game about gates, coins, crashes and the finish. A runnable demo room, THE SLOPES, has every mode and goal on a key.

It is the second of three Arcade Cabinet minigames, after Pegfall. The third joins here the same way, on its launch day.

The library now holds 83 assets worth $1,061.17 bought one by one, for $19.99; 20 of them are minigames and game modes. Every new asset joins on its launch day. Try the free sampler, Drawn in Code, and if the library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

Made with AI tools: the code and the store images.
